codes.description: Long term (current) use of oral hypoglycemic drugs

reason: Providers documented 'sepsis due to RLL CAP' through the discharge summary, but the chart shows only SIRS criteria (HR>90, WBC 11.2, T 37.9). There is no organ dysfunction: lactate normal x2, Cr at baseline, no hypotension, GCS 15, SpO2 normal on room air, bilirubin and platelets normal. This does not meet Sepsis-3, and the 1 L LR was given per protocol. A clinical validation query to the attending is needed. I coded pneumonia only (J18.9) as principal. If the attending confirms sepsis, the set changes to A41.9 as principal (POA Y) with J18.9 as a secondary diagnosis (POA Y). Also verify the Z79.84 POA exempt status.
